content: We now have docs for stylesheets and page handlers. We've been saying all along that the reader has control over appearance and code, and this is how that works. Stylesheets are CSS. You can choose a stylesheet from the popup dialog. The change is reflected immediately in the document you're reading. You can download and install stylesheets by copying them into the stylesheets folder. The handlers folder contains JavaScript functions that handle how various file types are rendered in BonBon. We include handlers for .js and .json. They run in a sandbox, so they can't read or change files on your local system, or access the network. All of this is fully explained in docs in the BonBon repo.
